reels.caption:
Americans don't know about the Mexican Disneyland

And they're missing out! KEY INFO ⬇️

Comment PARK and I'll send you the park details🌴

This is @xcaretpark theme park outside of Tulum

It's a 90 minute drive from Cancun, and only 40 minutes from Playa Del Carmen 🚕 You can even add transportation to your park ticket and they'll pick you up

We took a taxi there for 450 pesos (usd) and recommend arriving before opening so you're first in the park.

Our tickets were $138 per person which includes a full day at the park, buffet lunch, and their famous night show.

Xcaret has 6 other parks in the same area, and it's worth doing their Xplor adventure park the first day, the eco water park Xel-Ha the next, and then Xcaret!

They offer discounts when you bundle with their other parks, and 3 full park days (food included!) only cost us $370 per person.

Xcaret has STUNNING resort hotels like @hotelxcaretarte @hotelxcaretmexico that include unlimited access to all of their parks

OR you can find beautiful hotels Playa for $60-$80 a night and buy you park tickets separately! 🌴

Xcaret park is split into color paths so you can easily find your way around.

We strategically started on the white colored route and were able to see/experience the entire park in one day!

#themepark #travelbucketlist #travelhacks #waterpark #cancún

Credit: @heypouya
Mykonos is the ultimate paradise for those craving luxury and non-stop nightlife. Its breathtaking beaches, high-end clubs, and top restaurants create a lavish getaway where excess is the standard. The island's picturesque whitewashed houses and turquoise waters set the stage for relaxation and sun-kissed parties that rage all night. From opulent villas to VIP events with world-class DJs, Mykonos seamlessly blends sophistication with a hedonistic vibe, cementing its status as a haven for jet-setters and party enthusiasts.
